column2: Clause 2: This clause amends the First Schedule to the Social Security Contribution Levy Act,

column1: No. 25 of 2022, and the legal effect of that schedule as amended is to -

column2: restrict the exemption provided under item 24 of PART IA by setting out a time
period applicable to any institution referred to in such item;
make the exemption provided under item 4 of PART IB clearer to include the
wholesale and retail sale of such exempted articles;
expand  the  exemption  provided  under  item  4  of  PART  II  by  applying  the
exemption  to  services  provided  in  relation  to  international  transportation  by
exempt	the	financial	services	under	PART	II.
